title: Kuri language (Austronesian) — Grokipedia
text: Kuri, also known as Nabi or Modan (ISO 639-3: nbn), is an endangered Austronesian language spoken by a small indigenous community in about 16 villages along the Nabi River on the Bomberai Peninsula in southwestern West Papua, Indonesia.
